policy: Every entry must mirror an accepted-risk record in the registry above, and expires at review_by. Enforced by build/scripts/ci/validate-npm-audit.py in the Production Certification dependency-evidence job.

accepted.reason: RSC/framework-mode CSRF bypass. The dashboard is a client-only Vite SPA with no React Router server runtime, so the vulnerable path is unreachable in the shipped artifact. No patched 7.x exists; the fix line is react-router 8.3.0 and npm's suggested downgrade would drop seven minors of fixes. Exit path: migrate the dashboard to react-router v8 or adopt a patched 7.x if one appears.
